01

“Alif Lam Mim. The Byzantines have been defeated”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 30:2).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
Alif Lam Mim. The Byzantines have been defeated [al-Rum 2] he said: "He mentions the defeat of the Byzantines by Persia, the turn of fortune of the Byzantines over Persia, and the rejoicing of the believers at God's victory of the People of the Book over the people of idols." He said: "And the bidh' is between three and ten."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
الم غُلِبَتِ الرُّومُ [الروم: 2] قَالَ: " ذِكْرُ غَلَبَةِ فَارِسَ الرُّومَ، وَإِدَالَةِ الرُّومِ عَلَى فَارِسَ، وَفَرَحُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِنَصْرِ اللَّهِ أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْأَوْثَانِ، قَالَ: وَالْبِضْعُ مَا بَيْنَ الثَّلَاثِ إِلَى الْعَشَرَةِ "
Edition record 373046 · p. 538Link to report ↗

06

“the fitra of God upon which He has created people”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr and Ibn ʿAbbās (Q 30:30).

06
Explanation from Mujāhid 06

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
the fitra of God upon which He has created people [al-Rum 30] he said: "The fitra is the religion, Islam."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
فِطْرَةَ اللَّهِ الَّتِي فَطَرَ النَّاسَ عَلَيْهَا [الروم: 30] قَالَ: " الْفِطْرَةُ: الدِّينُ، الْإِسْلَامُ "
Edition record 373051 · p. 539Link to report ↗
07
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās 07

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Hammad ibn Salama related to us, from Qatada, from Ikrima, from Ibn Abbas, on His words:
no change in the creation of God [al-Rum 30] he said: "It is castration." Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, meaning: "the religion of God." Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from al-Mughira, from Ibrahim, the like of it; he said: "no change to the religion of God."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
لَا تَبْدِيلَ لِخَلْقِ اللَّهِ [الروم: 30] قَالَ: «هُوَ الْإِخْصَاءُ» . أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ يَعْنِي: «لِدِينِ اللَّهِ» . أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مِثْلَهُ، قَالَ: «لَا تَبْدِيلَ لِدَيْنِ اللَّهِ»
Edition record 373052 · p. 539Link to report ↗
07

“it does not increase with God”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 30:39).

08
Explanation from Mujāhid 08

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
it does not increase with God [al-Rum 39] he said: meaning "whoever gives a gift seeking something better in return, there is no reward in it."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
فَلَا يَرْبُو عِنْدَ اللَّهِ [الروم: 39] ، قَالَ: يَعْنِي «مَنْ أَعْطَى هَدِيَّةً يَبْتَغِي أَفْضَلَ مِنْهَا، فَلَا أَجْرَ فِيهَا»
Edition record 373053 · p. 539Link to report ↗
08

“Corruption has appeared on land and sea”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 30:41).

09
Explanation from Mujāhid 09

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
Corruption has appeared on land and sea [al-Rum 41] he said: "As for the land: the killing of his brother by the son of Adam; as for the sea: the king's seizing the ship by force."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
ظَهَرَ الْفَسَادُ فِي الْبِرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ [الروم: 41] قَالَ: " أَمَّا فِي الْبَرِّ: فَقَتَلَ ابْنُ آدَمَ أَخَاهُ، وَأَمَّا فِي الْبَحْرِ: فَأَخَذَ الْمَلِكُ السَّفِينَةَ غَصْبًا "
Edition record 373054 · p. 539Link to report ↗
